verdict.rationale: Drata's developer docs say it can "automate questionnaires" and manage a trust center (SafeBase), which is a first-party questionnaire-automation claim. The evidence is a single thin marketing line framed around programmatic API access. Nothing shows AI-generated answers drawn from the customer's controls or knowledge base, or a draft-and-review workflow. Missing for 10: evidence of AI answer drafting, grounding in actual controls/knowledge base, reviewer approval workflow, in-depth questionnaire docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
